source: 之之 口语句型库 v2（design/17）。定位=学习库：常用口语句型全覆盖，难度从简单句升级到复合句（从句/强调/虚拟/对比），目标「想到中文就能调出句型从容说英文」。前 5 类仍按 P2 骨架顺序，c6/c7 为全场景句型进阶。保留句沿用原 id（进度不丢）；删除的旧 id 不复用。focus 沿用弱点标签体系（6 值域）供薄弱条映射；scene[] 为跨话题换场景巩固题（题干只给中文）。

sentences.cn: 我想聊聊厦门的一个安静地方。
sentences.right: I'd like to talk about a quiet place in Xiamen.
sentences.formula: I'd like to talk about + 名词
sentences.note: 开门第一句万能句，任何话题直接套；like to 后用原形，别说 to talking。

scene.cn: 我想聊聊一本叫《小王子》的书。
scene.right: I'd like to talk about a book called The Little Prince.

scene.cn: 我想聊聊我最好的朋友。
scene.right: I'd like to talk about my best friend.

sentences.cn: 我想描述的那个人是我的舅舅。
sentences.right: The person I'd like to describe is my uncle.
sentences.formula: The + 名词 + I'd like to describe is ...
sentences.note: 自带定语从句的开头，把「人/地方/东西」换掉就能迁移，比 I'd like to 更显功力。

scene.cn: 我想描述的那个地方是我的大学。
scene.right: The place I'd like to describe is my university.

scene.cn: 我想描述的那样东西是我的旧手机。
scene.right: The thing I'd like to describe is my old phone.

sentences.cn: 说到放松，我想讲讲我家附近的一个公园。
sentences.right: When it comes to relaxing, I'd like to talk about a park near my home.
sentences.formula: When it comes to + 名词/doing, ...
sentences.note: 「说到…」引出话题，P1/P2 都能用；to 是介词，动词要加 -ing。

scene.cn: 说到美食，我想讲讲我妈做的面条。
scene.right: When it comes to food, I'd like to talk about the noodles made by my mom.

scene.cn: 说到运动，我想讲讲打羽毛球。
scene.right: When it comes to sports, I'd like to talk about playing badminton.

sentences.cn: 它位于厦门的海边。
sentences.right: It's located by the sea in Xiamen.
sentences.formula: It's located in/by + 地点
sentences.note: 地点类第二句交代位置；located 前必须有个 It's。

scene.cn: 它位于城市的中心。
scene.right: It's located in the centre of the city.

scene.cn: 它位于我家附近。
scene.right: It's located near my home.

sentences.cn: 它离我家大约二十分钟路程。
sentences.right: It's about twenty minutes from my home.
sentences.formula: It's about + 时间/距离 + from ...
sentences.note: 交代远近，数字随便换；别漏 It's。

scene.cn: 它离我们学校步行大约十分钟。
scene.right: It's about ten minutes' walk from my school.

scene.cn: 它离市中心大约五公里。
scene.right: It's about five kilometres from the city centre.

sentences.cn: 那是一个能让人放松的地方。
sentences.right: It's a place where you can relax.
sentences.formula: It's a place where + 主语 + can + 原形
sentences.note: where 定语从句，万能背景句，地点类通吃；where 后接完整句。

scene.cn: 那是一个能吃到地道当地菜的地方。
scene.right: It's a place where you can eat real local food.

scene.cn: 那是一个能安静读书的地方。
scene.right: It's a place where you can read quietly.

sentences.cn: 和大城市比起来，这里安静得多。
sentences.right: Compared with big cities, it is much quieter.
sentences.formula: Compared with + 对比对象, 主句 + 比较级
sentences.note: 比较句开场；比较级前可加 much 加强（much quieter，不是 more quieter）。

scene.cn: 和去年比起来，我的口语进步了很多。
scene.right: Compared with last year, my spoken English has improved a lot.

scene.cn: 和我妹妹比起来，我更外向。
scene.right: Compared with my younger sister, I am more outgoing.

sentences.cn: 那是我去过的最美的地方之一。
sentences.right: It is one of the most beautiful places I have ever been to.
sentences.formula: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 + I have ever + 过去分词
sentences.note: 最高级 + 完成时，口语高分组合；句尾的 to 别丢（been to）。

scene.cn: 那是我吃过的最好吃的一顿饭之一。
scene.right: It is one of the best meals I have ever had.

scene.cn: 那是我看过的最精彩的电影之一。
scene.right: It is one of the most exciting films I have ever watched.

sentences.cn: 我记得我们沿着湖边走了很久。
sentences.right: I remember that we walked along the lake for a long time.
sentences.formula: I remember that + 主语 + 过去式
sentences.note: 经历类万能叙事句；remember 后从句也要过去式。

scene.cn: 我记得我们拍了很多照片。
scene.right: I remember that we took a lot of photos.

scene.cn: 我记得他笑了很久。
scene.right: I remember that he laughed for a long time.

sentences.cn: 我们在那儿做的事就是拍照和野餐。
sentences.right: What we did there was take photos and have a picnic.
sentences.formula: What ... did was + 动词原形
sentences.note: what 主语从句强调「做的事」；was 后直接原形，不加 to 也不用过去式。

scene.cn: 我上周做的事就是复习考试。
scene.right: What I did last week was review for my exam.

scene.cn: 我们在那儿做的事就是逛街和吃小吃。
scene.right: What we did there was go shopping and eat snacks.

sentences.cn: 到那儿花了我大约一个小时。
sentences.right: It took me about an hour to get there.
sentences.formula: It took + 人 + 时间 + to do
sentences.note: 交代耗时；句尾 to do 别漏 to。

scene.cn: 完成这项任务花了我两天。
scene.right: It took me two days to finish the task.

scene.cn: 说服他花了我很长时间。
scene.right: It took me a long time to convince him.

sentences.cn: 我一到那儿就爱上了它。
sentences.right: As soon as I got there, I fell in love with it.
sentences.formula: As soon as + 过去时从句, 主句 + 过去时
sentences.note: 「一…就…」；前后两个动作都用过去式，讲故事超好用。

scene.cn: 我一开始玩这个游戏就停不下来。
scene.right: As soon as I started playing the game, I could not stop.

scene.cn: 我一见到那只小猫就喜欢上它了。
scene.right: As soon as I saw the little cat, I fell in love with it.

sentences.cn: 天气特别好，所以我们决定走路去那儿。
sentences.right: The weather was so nice that we decided to walk there.
sentences.formula: so + 形容词 + that + 从句
sentences.note: so...that = 太…以至于；that 后接完整从句，别写成 so...to。

scene.cn: 那家餐馆人特别多，我们等了快一个小时。
scene.right: The restaurant was so crowded that we waited for almost an hour.

scene.cn: 我当时太紧张了，一句话都说不出来。
scene.right: I was so nervous that I could not say a word.

sentences.cn: 最打动我的是那里的安静。
sentences.right: What impressed me most was the quietness there.
sentences.formula: What impressed me most was + 名词
sentences.note: what 主语从句，感受链起点，强调最深的印象；was 后接名词短语。

scene.cn: 最打动我的是他的耐心。
scene.right: What impressed me most was his patience.

scene.cn: 最打动我的是那里的美食。
scene.right: What impressed me most was the food there.

sentences.cn: 那次经历让我变得更自信了。
sentences.right: That experience made me feel more confident.
sentences.formula: ... made me feel + 形容词
sentences.note: 「让某人感到…」；feel 后形容词（confident，不是 confidently）。

scene.cn: 那部电影让我很感动。
scene.right: That movie made me feel touched.

scene.cn: 他的话让我很难过。
scene.right: His words made me feel sad.

sentences.cn: 我以前很怕当众说话，但现在不怕了。
sentences.right: I used to be afraid of speaking in public, but now I'm not.
sentences.formula: 主语 + used to + 原形, but now ...
sentences.note: 「以前→现在」对比句，P1/P3 万能；used to 后用原形。

scene.cn: 我以前不喜欢运动，但现在每周都跑步。
scene.right: I used to dislike sports, but now I run every week.

scene.cn: 我以前住在乡下，但现在住在城市。
scene.right: I used to live in the countryside, but now I live in the city.

sentences.cn: 那次旅行不仅是一段旅程，更是一堂课。
sentences.right: That trip was not only a journey, but also a lesson for me.
sentences.formula: not only + A, but also + B
sentences.note: 升华句神器；前后结构要对称（名词对名词、doing 对 doing）。

scene.cn: 那个地方不仅有美食，还有故事。
scene.right: That place is not only about food, but also about stories.

scene.cn: 这个游戏不仅好玩，还能帮我放松。
scene.right: This game is not only fun, but also helps me relax.

sentences.cn: 现在回想起来，那是我最快乐的一段时光。
sentences.right: Looking back, it was the happiest time of my life.
sentences.formula: Looking back, + 主句
sentences.note: 回忆口吻的开头，自然不背稿；逗号后接完整句。

scene.cn: 现在回想起来，我很庆幸当时坚持了下来。
scene.right: Looking back, I am really glad that I did not give up.

scene.cn: 现在回想起来，那次比赛对我意义重大。
scene.right: Looking back, that competition meant a lot to me.

sentences.cn: 如果有机会，我一定会再去一次。
sentences.right: If I have a chance, I will definitely go there again.
sentences.formula: If I + 现在时, I will + 原形
sentences.note: 万能收尾；if 从句用现在时，主句才用 will（不双 will）。

scene.cn: 如果有时间，我会再读一遍这本书。
scene.right: If I have time, I will read this book again.

scene.cn: 如果他来杭州，我会带他逛西湖。
scene.right: If he comes to Hangzhou, I will show him around the West Lake.

sentences.cn: 所以我认为那个地方值得一去。
sentences.right: So I think that place is worth visiting.
sentences.formula: ... be worth + doing
sentences.note: worth 后直接 doing，不加 to（worth to visit 是高频错）。

scene.cn: 我认为这本书值得一读。
scene.right: I think this book is worth reading.

scene.cn: 我认为这个习惯值得保持。
scene.right: I think this habit is worth keeping.

sentences.cn: 我很期待下次再去那儿。
sentences.right: I'm looking forward to going there again.
sentences.formula: ... look forward to + doing
sentences.note: 展望句；这里的 to 是介词，后面用 doing——中国学生最高频错误之一。

scene.cn: 我很期待见到我的笔友。
scene.right: I'm looking forward to meeting my pen friend.

scene.cn: 我很期待下个月的假期。
scene.right: I'm looking forward to the holiday next month.

sentences.cn: 总之，那是一次难忘的旅行。
sentences.right: All in all, it was an unforgettable trip.
sentences.formula: All in all, it was + 形容词 + 名词
sentences.note: 总结收尾；过去的经历用 was。

scene.cn: 总之，那是一顿很棒的晚餐。
scene.right: All in all, it was a wonderful dinner.

scene.cn: 总之，他是一位好老师。
scene.right: All in all, he is a good teacher.

sentences.cn: 这就是为什么我总是把它推荐给朋友。
sentences.right: That is why I always recommend it to my friends.
sentences.formula: That is why + 主句
sentences.note: 收尾神句：前文给理由，这句给结论，逻辑感直接拉满。

scene.cn: 这就是为什么我到现在还在玩它。
scene.right: That is why I am still playing it now.

scene.cn: 这就是为什么我想再回去一次。
scene.right: That is why I want to go back there again.

sentences.cn: 厦门以海鲜闻名，这也是我爱它的原因。
sentences.right: Xiamen is famous for its seafood, which is exactly why I love it.
sentences.formula: 陈述句, which + 补充说明（指前面整件事）
sentences.note: 非限制性定语从句：which 前必须有逗号，which 后接完整从句，不能另起一句。

scene.cn: 我舅舅做菜特别好吃，这就是全家人都爱吃他做的饭的原因。
scene.right: My uncle is really good at cooking, which is why the whole family loves his food.

scene.cn: 这个游戏一直在更新，这也是它还这么火的原因。
scene.right: The game keeps updating, which is why it is still so popular.

sentences.cn: 我喜欢那儿的最大原因是它足够安静。
sentences.right: The reason why I like it is that it is quiet enough.
sentences.formula: The reason why + 从句 is that + 从句
sentences.note: is 后面接 that，别写成 because（the reason...because 语义重复）。

scene.cn: 我学英语的最大原因是我想出国读研。
scene.right: The reason why I study English is that I want to study abroad.

scene.cn: 我推荐它的原因是它完全免费。
scene.right: The reason why I recommend it is that it is totally free.

sentences.cn: 虽然那天下雨，我们还是玩得很开心。
sentences.right: Although it was raining that day, we still had a great time.
sentences.formula: Although + 从句, 主句
sentences.note: 用了 Although 就不能用 but——一个句子只能要一个，中式英语头号坑。

scene.cn: 虽然我口语还不够好，但我一直在进步。
scene.right: Although my speaking is not good enough, I am still making progress.

scene.cn: 虽然排了一个小时的队，它还是很值得。
scene.right: Although we waited in line for an hour, it was still worth it.

sentences.cn: 我正在拍照的时候突然下雨了。
sentences.right: I was taking photos when it suddenly started to rain.
sentences.formula: 过去进行时 + when + 过去时（被打断）
sentences.note: 正在做的事用 was doing，突然发生的事用过去式；讲故事画面感最强的一句。

scene.cn: 我正在写作业的时候我妹妹冲进了房间。
scene.right: I was doing my homework when my younger sister rushed into my room.

scene.cn: 我们正在吃饭的时候手机响了。
scene.right: We were having dinner when my phone rang.

sentences.cn: 公园里有一个小湖，我们总在那儿拍照。
sentences.right: There is a small lake in the park where we always take photos.
sentences.formula: There is + 名词 + 地点 + where + 从句
sentences.note: There be + where 从句两连；where 前是地点名词，where 后接完整句。

scene.cn: 我家附近有一家小店，卖全城最好吃的包子。
scene.right: There is a small shop near my home where they sell the best baozi in the city.

scene.cn: 那是一个我们全家每年都会去的地方。
scene.right: That is a place where my family goes every year.

sentences.cn: 我发现开口说出声才是最快的进步方式。
sentences.right: I found that speaking out loud is the fastest way to improve.
sentences.formula: I found that + 完整句
sentences.note: I found that 后接完整从句（可说一般事实）；里面主系表别缺 is。

scene.cn: 我发现说得慢一点反而听起来更流利。
scene.right: I found that speaking slowly actually sounds more fluent.

scene.cn: 我发现他和我有不少共同爱好。
scene.right: I found that he and I share a lot of hobbies.

sentences.cn: 如果我家住海边，我每天都会去散步。
sentences.right: If I lived by the sea, I would go for a walk every day.
sentences.formula: If + 过去式, I would + 原形
sentences.note: 虚拟语气：假设的事从句用过去式、主句 would；If I were you 同理（用 were 不用 was）。

scene.cn: 如果我有更多时间，我会学做饭。
scene.right: If I had more time, I would learn to cook.

scene.cn: 如果我今晚早点睡，明天就会更有精神。
scene.right: If I went to bed earlier tonight, I would feel more energetic tomorrow.

sentences.cn: 是我舅舅第一次带我去那儿的。
sentences.right: It was my uncle who took me there for the first time.
sentences.formula: It was + 强调的人/物 + who/that + 剩余部分
sentences.note: 强调句：去掉 It was...who 句子照样成立，它只负责强调谁干的。

scene.cn: 是我妹妹教会了我这个游戏。
scene.right: It was my younger sister who taught me this game.

scene.cn: 是那次旅行让我爱上了旅行。
scene.right: It was that trip that made me fall in love with travelling.

sentences.cn: 独自旅行教会了我独立。
sentences.right: Travelling alone taught me to be independent.
sentences.formula: Doing sth + 谓语（动名词作主语，谓语用单数）
sentences.note: 动作当主语用 doing；谓语按单数处理。

scene.cn: 每天背单词让我的词汇量大了很多。
scene.right: Learning words every day has made my vocabulary much bigger.

scene.cn: 早起对我这种学生来说太难了。
scene.right: Getting up early is really hard for a student like me.

sentences.cn: 有些人喜欢大城市，而我更喜欢乡下。
sentences.right: Some people love big cities, while I prefer the countryside.
sentences.formula: A 句, while B 句（前后对比）
sentences.note: while 表对比，不是「当…时候」；前后各自是完整句。

scene.cn: 我的朋友喜欢手游，而我喜欢电脑游戏。
scene.right: My friends like mobile games, while I prefer PC games.

scene.cn: 城市生活方便，而乡下生活安静。
scene.right: Life in the city is convenient, while life in the countryside is quiet.

sentences.cn: 这个地方变得越来越火了。
sentences.right: This place is getting more and more popular.
sentences.formula: get/become + more and more + 形容词
sentences.note: 「越来越」= more and more；多音节形容词用 more，短形容词用 -er and -er（better and better）。

scene.cn: 用 AI 学英语变得越来越普遍。
scene.right: Using AI to learn English is becoming more and more common.

scene.cn: 我妹妹的画越画越好了。
scene.right: My younger sister is drawing better and better.

sentences.cn: 我学英语已经学了三年了。
sentences.right: I have been learning English for three years.
sentences.formula: have been + doing + for + 时间
sentences.note: 现在完成进行时：从过去一直持续到现在；聊爱好/习惯的经历必用，P1 加分。

scene.cn: 我玩这个游戏已经玩了一年。
scene.right: I have been playing this game for a year.

scene.cn: 她一直在等他的回复。
scene.right: She has been waiting for his reply.
